You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 33 of 50 (script duration 174.0 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
...
E23: After examining the dying Dowager Duchess's blackened fingernails and consulting her late mother's remedy journal, Lady Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic—only for someone to arrive at the bedroom door just as she begins concocting the antidote.
E24: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
E25: Deep in the misty forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and uncovers the wound inflicted by Lady Catherine, reacting with fury and protective concern upon learning that someone is systematically poisoning the Dowager Duchess with arsenic.
E26: While secretly administering a charcoal antidote to the poisoned Dowager Duchess in the dead of night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess suddenly recognizes a distinctive family ring on her hand and fiercely demands the truth about her identity.
E27: The Dowager Duchess realizes Juliana's wedding ring bears the Ashbourne crest belonging to her lost son, but before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning the Duchess.
E28: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.
E29: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.
E30: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.
E31: Catherine enters the wet cells armed with a red-hot iron and Juliana's late mother's botanical book, subjecting the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment until Juliana's unyielding pride pushes Catherine to a violent brink.
E32: Cornered and chained in the damp dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity and the truth about love and worth, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
Direct lead-in to E33: Following Catherine's dungeon interrogation of Juliana, the conspiracy against Juliana deepens as an aristocratic lord forces a testimony of witchcraft out of the young maid whose brother Juliana saved.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Under cruel coercion and threats to send her seven-year-old brother to the county gaol, a young maid is manipulated into giving false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-5.2] SCREEN: Wide shot of a dimly lit, wood-paneled library study. An aristocratic lord in formal dark attire stands facing a young maid standing nervously by the open door.
[L002 2.5-4.8] LORD (Cold, Authoritative): "Your brother is breathing again."
[L003 4.0-6.5] ACTION: The young maid steps inside, bowing with a submissive curtsy, keeping her head low and hands clasped.
[L004 5.2-8.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the maid trembling as she raises her eyes hesitantly.
[L005 6.5-8.5] MAID (Meek, Hesitant): "Yes, my Lord."
[L006 8.8-12.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Lord standing beside his mahogany desk, looking down with cold, calculating scrutiny.
[L007 9.5-11.8] LORD (Probing): "And who saved him?"
[L008 12.0-14.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid's anxious, innocent face.
[L009 13.0-14.5] MAID (Quiet, Truthful): "Lady Juliana."
[L010 14.8-17.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord's hand slowly rotating the heavy gold signet ring on his pinky finger.
[L011 15.5-17.5] LORD (Measured, Demanding): "Tell me how."
[L012 17.8-21.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the maid nervously wringing her apron fabric.
[L013 19.5-21.0] MAID (Faltering): "She... she used herbs."
[L014 21.0-23.0] SCREEN: Close-up on the Lord leaning forward abruptly, his piercing gaze bearing down.
[L015 21.2-22.8] LORD (Sharp, Intimidating): "What herbs?"
[L016 23.0-26.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the frightened maid looking down, shrinking back.
[L017 24.5-26.2] MAID (Whispering, Nervous): "I don't know."
[L018 26.5-29.2] SCREEN: Low-angle shot looking up at the imposing Lord towering above her.
[L019 27.5-29.0] LORD (Stern): "You watched her."
[L020 29.2-32.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid, tears beginning to glisten on her cheeks as she defends Juliana.
[L021 29.8-32.0] MAID (Tearful, Sincere): "I watched her save him."
[L022 32.8-36.5] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning away slowly past the lamp-lit desk toward the rain-streaked window.
[L023 34.0-36.2] LORD (Coldly Dismissive): "That is not what I asked."
[L024 36.5-40.2] SCREEN: Medium two-shot framing the maid from behind as the Lord steps back toward her with commanding stillness.
[L025 37.5-40.0] LORD (Accusatory): "Did she use her mother's book?"
[L026 40.2-44.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid trembling, tears spilling down her face.
[L027 42.2-43.6] MAID (Quietly Weeping): "Yes."
[L028 44.2-49.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord's sinister, unyielding face.
[L029 44.8-48.8] LORD (Insistent, Cornering): "Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?"
[L030 49.2-52.5] SCREEN: Medium shot of the maid clutching her hands together tightly, overwhelmed with guilt.
[L031 50.0-51.6] MAID (Choked Sob): "Yes."
[L032 52.5-56.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord's mouth curling into a sinister, predatory smile.
[L033 53.0-56.5] LORD (Sly, Sinister): "And did she perform anything unusual?"
[L034 56.8-59.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid gasping, shaking her head vigorously in panic.
[L035 57.4-58.8] MAID (Desperate, Denying): "No!"
[L036 59.0-64.2] SCREEN: Profile medium two-shot as the Lord looms inches from the maid's face.
[L037 59.0-61.0] LORD (Low, Menacing): "Think carefully."
[L038 61.2-63.5] LORD (Ruthless): "Your brother is still a pauper."
[L039 64.2-68.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Lord's cold eyes and hawkish profile speaking with chilling finality.
[L040 64.4-68.5] LORD (Threatening): "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise."
[L041 68.5-70.0] ACTION: The maid gasps in sheer terror, her chest heaving as tears stream.
[L042 68.8-73.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid clutching her chest with trembling hands, crying desperately.
[L043 69.5-73.0] MAID (Begging, Heartbroken): "Please, my Lord... he is only seven!"
[L044 73.2-75.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord staring down without an ounce of pity.
[L045 73.2-75.0] LORD (Cold, Unwavering): "Then help him."
[L046 75.5-79.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid weeping profusely, cornered and helpless.
[L047 76.8-79.0] MAID (Crying, Shattered): "What do you want me to say?!"
[L048 79.5-84.8] SCREEN: Wide shot of the study as the Lord stands calmly before the trembling servant.
[L049 79.6-80.5] LORD (Deceptive): "The truth."
[L050 81.0-84.5] LORD (Leading, Deliberate): "She drew something around the bed, did she not?"
[L051 84.8-89.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid stammering through her tears.
[L052 85.5-88.8] MAID (Trembling, Reluctant): "She... placed dried herbs around him."
[L053 89.0-94.8] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Lord standing right beside her shoulder, whispering in her ear like an insidious specter.
[L054 89.0-90.5] LORD (Hypnotic, Coercive): "Around him."
[L055 91.0-92.5] LORD (Coercive): "Like a circle?"
[L056 93.0-94.5] MAID (Faint, Defeated): "Yes."
[L057 94.8-98.5] SCREEN: Close-up from behind the maid as the Lord leans close to her ear.
[L058 95.0-98.0] LORD (Whispering, Trap Snapping): "And she opened her mother's book..."
[L059 98.5-100.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the maid's tear-drenched eyes and quivering lips.
[L060 98.5-100.0] MAID (Sobbing): "Yes."
[L061 100.8-104.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord delivering the final trap.
[L062 101.0-104.0] LORD (Sinister): "...and spoke words you could not understand."
[L063 104.2-107.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid gasping out in desperate agony.
[L064 104.5-106.5] MAID (Desperately Defending): "She was praying!"
[L065 107.5-111.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord grinning with sinister triumph.
[L066 108.0-111.5] LORD (Taunting): "Praying... or chanting?"
[L067 111.8-113.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid breaking down completely.
[L068 112.0-113.5] MAID (Hysterically Sobbing): "I don't know!"
[L069 113.8-119.5] SCREEN: Medium shot as the Lord paces slowly, pointing his finger with clinical, legal precision.
[L070 114.0-116.5] LORD (Calculating, Relentless): "You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs."
[L071 116.8-119.5] LORD (Relentless): "You saw her use a forbidden book."
[L072 119.5-123.5] SCREEN: Close-up profile of the Lord leaning in right in front of the sobbing maid.
[L073 119.8-122.8] LORD (Condemning): "You heard words you could not understand."
[L074 123.5-126.8] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of the Lord's mouth and calculating eyes as he pronounces the lethal word.
[L075 124.5-126.5] LORD (Deadly, Resolute): "That is witchcraft."
[L076 126.8-131.8] SCREEN: Medium two-shot as the maid steps forward, pleading passionately against his chest.
[L077 126.8-131.5] MAID (Crying Out, Desperate): "No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!"
[L078 131.8-134.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord calmly watching her futile resistance.
[L079 132.0-134.0] LORD (Cold, Final): "That will be your testimony."
[L080 134.5-137.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid's face frozen in horrified realization.
[L081 134.5-137.0] MAID (Gasping, Shocked): "My testimony?!"
[L082 137.8-140.5] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord delivering the ultimatum without blinking.
[L083 138.0-140.0] LORD (Unyielding): "Before the magistrate."
[L084 140.5-144.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid grabbing both sides of her head, screaming out in utter grief and guilt.
[L085 140.5-144.0] MAID (Wailing, Tormented): "I never said she was a witch!"
[L086 144.8-149.2] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot of the Lord turning his back and walking back behind his desk.
[L087 145.0-146.5] LORD (Chillingly Detached): "You do not need to."
[L088 146.8-149.0] LORD (Chillingly Detached): "I have already written the story for you."
[L089 149.2-152.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the maid clutching her cheeks, crying in heartbreak.
[L090 149.5-152.0] MAID (Sobbing): "She saved my brother..."
[L091 152.2-156.2] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lord turning back, resting one hand upon the desk with cold finality.
[L092 152.5-156.0] LORD (Inexorable): "And now... you will save your brother."
[L093 156.2-159.5] ACTION: The maid's knees buckle completely. She collapses forward onto the polished dark wood floor, groveling in total despair.
[L094 156.2-159.5] SCREEN: High angle looking down as the maid falls prostrate on the floor.
[L095 159.0-161.5] MAID (Weeping, Broken): "I am sorry, Lady Juliana..."
[L096 159.5-163.8] SCREEN: Low-angle shot of the Lord looking down dismissively at the prostrate maid.
[L097 161.8-164.5] LORD (Cold, Merciless): "Save your tears for the trial."
[L098 163.8-174.0] SCREEN: Side medium shot of the maid kneeling crumpled on the floor in the dimly lit study, her face buried in both hands, weeping uncontrollably as the scene slowly fades into the dark silence.
[L099 164.5-174.0] ACTION: The heartbroken maid weeps silently in the shadow of the desk, consumed by guilt and powerlessness.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}

YOUR PREVIOUS ANSWER:
{"candidates": [{"title": "Forced to Lie or Die", "segments": [{"start_line": "L064", "end_line": "L068"}, {"start_line": "L093", "end_line": "L099"}], "hook_line": "L064", "hook": "The Lord delivers a cold, lethal threat: 'One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.'", "hook_quote": "One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.", "cliffhanger_line": "L099", "cliffhanger": "The maid collapses in total despair, having been forced to betray her savior.", "cliffhanger_quote": "", "why_it_works": "It showcases a villainous manipulation that makes the audience desperate for Juliana's justice.", "setup_needed": "none", "spoiler_risk": "low", "self_score": 9}]}

Some of your candidates broke the hard rules. Code computed these problems:
- "Forced to Lie or Die": hook_quote is not an exact quote of L064 ('"She was praying!"')

Return the same JSON shape again with corrected versions of ONLY the rejected candidates (same titles). Fix the boundaries by choosing different line IDs; keep the idea if it is good. Remember: 20-60 s total, hook_line starts within the first 3 s, cliffhanger_line inside the promo near its end, quotes copied exactly. Set episode_summary to "".
